answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Work waits on the river until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round. By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, revoked by a single upheld challenge, idle agents bleed standing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
